title: Adaptive Traffic Blueprint Engine for Incremental Model Rollouts
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Build a reusable 'Traffic Blueprint' composer that lets engineers and PMs declare incremental rollout strategies for served models. The blueprint is a compact declarative schema supporting traffic splits, timed step schedules, per-step guardrails (latency, error-rate, hallucination score thresholds), shadow routing, and automatic rollback triggers. The engine should validate blueprints, synthesize runtime routing rules, expose a dry-run/simulation mode, and emit structured events for the Console and alerting pipelines. Non-goals: full experimentation analytics (we will integrate with existing metrics infra), model training/selection logic.
acceptance_criteria: Blueprint schema v1 defined and documented in Confluence with examples for canary, A/B, and shadow flows
Engine validates blueprint and returns actionable error messages for invalid configs
Runtime can apply a blueprint to live traffic with step-scheduled splits and metric guardrails
Automatic rollback triggers when guardrail thresholds breached (configurable window) and rollback is recorded in audit log
Dry-run simulation produces expected synthetic traffic distribution and a report of potential guardrail violations
End-to-end integration test covering canary -> steady -> rollback executed in CI with synthetic traffic harness
comments: 2026-02-16 - Kickoff: scoped initial MVP to handle 3 step schedules, percent-based splits, shadow routing, and 3 guardrail metric types (p95 latency, 5xx rate, custom hallucination_score). Action: Jin to prototype schema, Sofia to draft Confluence spec.

2026-02-20 - Prototype update: initial schema draft pushed to Confluence (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/BLUEPRINT-v1) and sample YAML posted in PR #673 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/rollouts/pull/673). Early feedback: need clearer semantics for overlapping traffic rules across routes.

2026-02-25 - Design decision: adopt explicit 'scope' field (route, model, customer) to disambiguate cross-cutting policies. Recorded rationale in Confluence. Action: add validation rule to prevent scope escalation.

2026-03-01 - Simulation harness: ran dry-run against synthetic workload generator (github actions job: rollout-sim). Result: canary step mis-specified caused 0% traffic to reach new variant in one config; added guard to detect dead-steps in validator.

2026-03-04 - Security/Compliance review kickoff: reviewed whether audit entries contain PII — decided only to log blueprint metadata and metric deltas; raw request payloads are not stored. Documented in security ticket SEC-88.

2026-03-06 - PR feedback (ENG review): reviewers asked for clearer rollout observability hooks (token-level delta metrics). Action: expose per-step metric tags and trunk route id for Console integration. Linking to PR #689 for instrumentation changes.

2026-03-08 - Integration test added: canary->steady->rollback flow passes in staging using runtime-1.24 image. Observability dashboard (dash: /d/rollout/ENG-43901) shows p95 spike and automatic rollback triggered as expected. Next: finalize docs and schedule demo with PM and Support.
